findings: Local BLS 2013, NBER 2023, and IMF 2024 full-text hashes match both author prior-art and literature-archive records.
Official BLS and IMF pages confirm June 12, 2013 and January 12, 2024; NBER confirms October 2023 only.
The NBER first_public_at value 2023-10-31 is not verified as an exact day; the PDF has an October 9 draft footer.
The AEA lists a Spring 2024 Journal of Economic Perspectives version of Barlevy et al.; its full text was not reviewed here.
Raw BLS bodies and acquisition hashes agree, but the claimed API retrieval timestamp is supported by project logs rather than an independent signature.

findings: The conclusion's narrowing language is supported by selected annual conditional means, but cannot establish a stable trend or full return to baseline.
A broad unemployment band leaves a 0.292 percentage-point difference in mean unemployment across periods.
The author correctly disclaims a treatment effect, matching-efficiency inference, and independent-month standard errors.
The IMF's vacancy denominator differs from the pilot's BLS openings-rate denominator.
Raw JSON hashes match acquisition logs and independently recalculated headline values match results and manuscript rounding.
The current main.tex hash differs from the build and coverage input hash; the current source contains an IMF denominator sentence absent from the released PDF.
Replication and build pass records are author-side validation, not scientific acceptance or a current-source build certificate.
Placeholder logic and substantive reviews remain blocked.
